page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin (two notes beside lines 23 and 26-27). No footnotes below the text. Page number and running head at the top.

main_text.p: principem & ordines agri in curia Gronin-gana per legatos Geldricos senatumq; vrbanum sic convenit, ut ipsi in fide principis essent, & haeredum eius in perpetuum: princeps & haeredes integra servarent ipsis privilegia, jura, instituta, leges, consuetudines, secundum foedera & pacta olim inter ipsos & civitatem inita. Sic in nomen Geldricum ab ordinibus juratum, praemissa conditione hac, non diutius valituram vim juramenti huius, quam Geldrus tueri regionem posset. Et mox haec pacta a principe sunt signata die Junij xx. Verum cum progressu temporis cum longius paulatim tendere, & a pactis recedere, & civitatis jura aratre deprehenderetur GELDRVS, à MARVVICO praetore primum incitatus, cui simultas cum senatu intercedebat, deinde irritatus, quod, belle pro Balthasaro Esenfi in Frisia Orientali contra Ennonem Comitem vicinum suscepto, in ejus impensas tributu sibi a civitate negaretur, & suapte natura potentia per fas & nefas augenda auidus, & turbulentus, occasione rapta, quam fors offerebat, per MEINHARDVM Hammenfem claAnno M. [?] XXXV I.- rum militia virum, Daniae regis auspicia profitentem, occultis mandatis suis instructum, adducti copys tumultus in agro, & ad ipsas portas Carolus Oeld. pass[?] violat,urbis cieret, suburbia vastaret & incenderet, DAMMONAM summa festinatione muniret, postremo in colloquio Esena componenda rei causa instituto per Henricu Grovium ERCLENII dominum legatum suum, & Hacfordum militum praefe-

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Uncertain readings: "pratore" (may be printed "praetore"), "belle" (possibly "bello" or similar), "Esenfi in" and "Esena" (possibly a place name), "tributu", "ctis" at the start of the line 26 (possibly partly hidden by the margin note), "Hacfordum", and the marginal notes "Anno M. [?] XXXV I." and "pass[?]". The text at the start of the page continues from the previous page. The printed hyphen at "cla-" and "profi-" and the last line "praefe-" are kept. The first paragraph and the rest of the page form one continuous paragraph.
